Team —

Quick nudge ahead of the EOW submission: Greenleaf is on a tight approval timetable and we need to lock stage/commit signals + consolidated evidence in the escrow folder by EOD Thursday. Action plan below — please read and ack: 

1) Stage hygiene: update Salesforce/HubSpot stage to either COMMIT or DISQUALIFY by 3pm PT Wednesday. If you move to COMMIT, add the reason + next-step owner in the notes field.

2) Evidence escrow: all artifacts (PO language summary, security checklist excerpt, pricing snapshot, demo recording link) go in the shared escrow folder here: https://drive.redwood.com/escrow/greenleaf-evidence (use the template attached). Filename convention: <dealid>_<account>_<artifact>.

3) Pre-call coverage: 15m standup Thursday 4:15pm PT to align presenters for Friday review. Who will present the technical/PS ask + who will own pricing?

Attachments: evidence_template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub).

Please reply with: 1) stage changes you made, 2) which artifacts you’ll upload, 3) who’s presenting. I’ll run the 15m pre-call and consolidate.

Thanks —
So/J
SoJin Lee
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
